attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 30 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the woman is the folder's own: a rich woman of Caesarea in Cappadocia, warred upon over her property by a powerful man who denounced her as a Christian, condemned, thrown into the fire, and her body found whole. The two calendars set her under different emperors — doxologia under «decrees of the emperor Diocletian», saint.gr «τα διατάγματα του Ιουλιανού» and in the days of Basil the Great, who wrote to Palladius on her behalf — and neither is corrected by the other; the disagreement is recorded in the life. The page gives no year, so no `dates` object is proposed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. It prints no hymn.
